items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: we had guys in the band like John Kirby... during that era

ctx.x: Yes. "Chloe." That was done May 8, in Chicago.

Of course, you know that was part one and part two. You know the band on the other side was John Kirby and that great little outfit that he had. Now we made a slow version of that with the big band, and John Kirby had the swing side.
